title: OpenAI - Widespread feature degradation
text:
Service: OpenAI
Incident: Widespread feature degradation
Status: resolved
Impact: major
Started: None
Resolved: 2026-10-15T18:56:00Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-15T18:56:00Z: resolved - All impacted services have now fully recovered.
- 2026-10-15T17:13:05Z: monitoring - We have applied the mitigation and are monitoring the recovery.
- 2026-10-15T16:35:24Z: investigating - We are investigating widespread feature degradation, including issues affecting logins and signups in the ChatGPT iOS/Android apps. We will provide updates as we learn more.
- 2026-10-15T16:29:26Z: investigating - We are investigating an issue affecting logins and signups across all ChatGPT mobile applications. We will provide updates as we learn more.

incident_updates.body: All impacted services have now fully recovered.
We have applied the mitigation and are monitoring the recovery.
We are investigating widespread feature degradation, including issues affecting logins and signups in the ChatGPT iOS/Android apps. We will provide updates as we learn more.
We are investigating an issue affecting logins and signups across all ChatGPT mobile applications. We will provide updates as we learn more.
